players.product: Gemma Power Systems EPC for combined-cycle gas plants serving data-center load (4.1 GW in backlog) plus data-center thermal expansion / energy storage tank fabrication

quarterly_data.signal: Argan's first quarter of fiscal 2027 (ended April 30, 2026): record consolidated revenues of $291.0 million, up $97.3 million or 50.2% from $193.7 million a year earlier, with higher revenues across all business segments; Power segment growth was driven by the continued ramp-up of construction on recently awarded contracts. Gross profit was $61.1 million (21.0% of revenues vs 19.0%), net income $46.1 million or $3.24 per diluted share, and adjusted EBITDA $56.4 million (19.4% margin vs 16.3%).
quarterly_data.figure: revenue $291.0 million (+50.2%), quarter ended April 30, 2026; gross margin 21.0%; net income $46.1 million; adjusted EBITDA $56.4 million

quarterly_data.signal: Consolidated project backlog was approximately $2.8 billion as of April 30, 2026, compared with approximately $2.9 billion at January 31, 2026. The CEO said the project pipeline remains robust, with heightened demand as the electrification of everything, onshoring of domestic manufacturing and the proliferation of data centers create an urgent need for additional energy infrastructure, and that gas-fired plants remain the ideal solution for reliable, uninterrupted power.
